mapper.sql: a.id, a.uuid, a.author_uuid, a.building_id, a.title, a.body, a.relic_root_content, a.img_urls, a.type, a.agree_count, a.collect_count, a.chat_count, a.score, a.relic_status, a.relic_generation, a.relic_pool_round, a.create_time, a.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM articles WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted =0
SELECT * FROM articles WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted =0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM articles a WHERE a.building_id = #{buildingId} AND a.type = 'normal' AND a.is_deleted =0 ORDER BY a.score DESC, a.id DESCa.id DESC
SELECT FROM articles a WHERE a.type = 'normal' AND a.is_deleted =0 AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR a.body LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY a.score DESC, a.id DESC
SELECT FROM articles a WHERE a.type = 'relic' AND a.relic_status = 'growing' AND a.is_deleted =0 ORDER BY a.id DESC

SELECT FROM articles a INNER JOIN ( SELECT building_id, MAX(score) AS max_score FROM articles WHERE author_uuid = #{authorUuid} AND type = 'normal' AND is_deleted =0 GROUP BY building_id ) best ON a.building_id = best.building_id AND a.score = best.max_score WHERE a.author_uuid = #{authorUuid} AND a.type = 'normal' AND a.is_deleted =0 ORDER BY a.score DESC, a.id DESC
SELECT FROM articles a WHERE a.author_uuid = #{authorUuid} AND a.is_deleted =0 ORDER BY a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC
SELECT FROM articles a INNER JOIN reactions r ON r.article_id = a.id AND r.type = 'collect' WHERE r.user_uuid = #{userUuid} AND a.is_deleted =0 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE articles SET is_deleted =1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted =0
UPDATE articles SET agree_count = agree_count +1, score = score +1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted =0
UPDATE articles SET collect_count = collect_count +1, score = score +3, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted =0
UPDATE articles SET chat_count = chat_count +1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted =0

UPDATE articles SET body = CONCAT(body, #{content}), relic_pool_round = relic_pool_round +1, relic_last_merged_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted =0

UPDATE articles SET body = relic_root_content, relic_generation = relic_generation +1, relic_pool_round =0, relic_last_merged_user_uuid = NULL, relic_last_merged_at = NULL, relic_last_destroyed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted =0
